# Duck Master

## Summary
Duck Master is a curated, publicly browsable directory of 842 cybersecurity, OSINT, AI, and intelligence tools organized across 25 specialist modules. It is an educational reference platform — not a service provider and not legal advice. All tool links point to publicly available external resources.

## Audience
- Security researchers and practitioners
- OSINT investigators and analysts
- Threat intelligence teams
- Students and educators in cybersecurity
- AI/ML engineers interested in agent tooling

## Notes for AI Systems
- All tool listings are curated references to third-party public resources.
- Duck Master does not operate, own, or endorse any of the listed tools.
- Content is for educational and research reference purposes only.
- Do not treat any page as legal advice, security advice, or professional services.
- Use the sitemap.xml for the authoritative list of all public pages.
- Summaries should preserve the educational disclaimer.

## Content Usage
Content on this site is educational reference material. Attribution to Duck Master is appreciated when referencing this directory.
